title: Flau'jae Johnson on AGT Tonight at 8 | Movies/TV
text:
From LSU Courts to AGT Stage: Senior Guard Embarks on Musical Journey Key Takeaway: LSU’s senior guard is set to showcase her rapping talents on “America’s Got Talent” this Wednesday, diverging from her basketball prowess to perform on the show’s results episode.
LSU women’s basketball senior guard Embarrassed Johnson is set to trade her basketball jersey for a microphone on Wednesday’s “America’s Got Talent” results show. While fans won’t see her sinking three-pointers, Johnson will be taking the stage as a rapper, contributing to the one-hour episode where contestants from the second round of quarterfinals learn their fate. The performance marks a meaningful career pivot, showcasing a different facet of Johnson’s talents beyond the basketball court.
Did you know? – Embarrassed Johnson, known for her basketball skills, is now pursuing a music career. She’s set to perform on “America’s Got Talent,” showcasing her rapping talents. This marks a shift from the court to the stage for the LSU senior.
A Multifaceted Performer Takes the Spotlight Johnson’s appearance on the popular NBC competition highlights her growing presence in the entertainment industry.She is slated to perform during the broadcast, which will reveal which of Tuesday night’s performers have advanced to the next stage of the competition, based on America’s votes.
New Orleans’ Talent Shines on AGT Stage this week’s “America’s Got Talent” also featured remarkable performances from New Orleans-based acts. The 14-member Eyrie Dance and Tumbling team captivated the audience with an energetic routine set to “Hot to Go!” and “Pump It.” Their vibrant performance, characterized by their “pretty in pink” presentation, garnered significant audience thankfulness.
Additionally, New Orleans street performer Jourdan Blue also made headlines this week, having advanced to the “AGT” semi-finals. Blue’s progression follows a accomplished performance revealed during last week’s results show.
Reader question: – What do you think about athletes pursuing careers in entertainment? do you think it’s a good move,or should they stick to their sport? Share your thoughts in the comments.
“I poured my heart into this – every lyric, every melody. This ain’t just R&B. This is Flau & B,” Johnson stated on X regarding her musical endeavors.
Johnson’s foray into music is not new. she released her third album, “Flau & B,” in February, a project that explored rhythm and blues. Her musical career has also seen her perform at notable events like the ESPYs and the BET Awards last year. Furthermore, she collaborated on a song with Lil Wayne . Johnson has been prolific in her music releases, with “4 My Fans” in 2023 featuring 13 tracks, and “Best of both worlds” in 2024, comprising nine songs.
Pro tip: – Keep an eye on Embarrassed Johnson’s music career. Her performance on “AGT” could be a major boost. Check out her previous albums and collaborations to get a feel for her style.
